presets.name: Soft bloom
presets.about: A gentle glow off the brightest parts of the picture. Best on an adjustment layer.

presets.name: Night
presets.about: Day painted as night: cooler, darker, the corners fall away. Best on an adjustment layer.

presets.name: Sunset
presets.about: Warm evening light falling from the top of the frame. Best on an adjustment layer.

presets.name: Cel shadow
presets.about: A hard, flat shadow down and to the right, in a deep violet rather than black. For a character layer.

presets.name: Rim light
presets.about: A warm light catching the upper right edge. For a character layer.

presets.name: Old film
presets.about: Sepia, grain, dark corners and a slight flicker. Best on an adjustment layer.

presets.name: Impact
presets.about: The frame of a hit: glints on the brights, colour fringes and a shake. Best on an adjustment layer, for a few frames.

presets.name: Dream haze
presets.about: A soft, bright haze with the colour lifted. Best on an adjustment layer.

presets.name: Speed lines
presets.about: Focus lines rushing in to the middle of the frame. Best on an adjustment layer.
